scope: Unfiltered Manual order in one saved standalone List; exact membership, local completion and shared content survive reorder and relaunch.
limitations: Filtered Manual reordering, cross-List Move/Add, external/cross-window writes and multi-selection are not qualified.
Mobile context-menu quiescence delays remain in raw logs; these tests do not establish user latency or long-list performance.
Mac automatic window restoration, broader accessibility/keyboard, orientation/resizing and final human review remain open.
Core schema 7 and portable format 1 are unchanged; CloudKit, signing, physical devices and Share remain unqualified.
Historical and final executions have separate source hashes; earlier passes are not attributed to later source revisions.
macGestureDiagnosisNote: Mac attempts through MacDeclaredDragQualification used the touch API and cannot establish a native reordering API defect. Proper mouse attempts subsequently failed in the List and the table with title Buttons. The isolated Text-versus-Button table comparison found the interaction conflict. Final Mac rows use native Table selection and row Transferable drag/drop, with plain Text titles and a separate completion Button. The app-owned identity-only transfer type remains declared in Info.plist. Debug logging and disposable probe tests were removed.
